extract_scalars_from_info_single: extract scalar values from a single gym environment info dictionary by filtering non-scalar metrics
extract_scalars_from_info_nested: extract scalar values from a nested info dictionary with custom ignore keys to exclude specific metrics
extract_scalars_from_infos_batch: extract scalar values from a list of gym environment info dictionaries and aggregate into lists
extract_scalars_from_infos_ignore: extract scalar values from multiple info dictionaries while ignoring specified non-scalar metric keys
NON_SCALAR_METRICS_constant: reference the set of non-scalar metric names like top_down_map and collisions.is_collision
